From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>, Jada Williams <jada_williams@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Rivera <hannah_rivera@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Console workflow review: Dedicated staged rollouts (timeline, promote/hold/abort, gate evidence)

Hi all — pulling together a quick review to lock the Console workflow + backend contract for Dedicated staged rollouts before we get too far into implementation.

Goal for this week: align on (1) UX flow and terminology (promote vs force-promote, hold/freeze semantics), (2) the Console backend endpoints needed for the timeline + gate evidence, and (3) dependencies/ordering w/ policy engine + telemetry tagging.

Proposed review (45 min): Tue 2/11 11:00–11:45a PT

Agenda:
1) Timeline component states: Draft → Running → Held → Aborted → Completed
2) Action availability rules (who can Promote/Hold/Abort/Force)
3) Gate evidence panel: how we present “pass/fail/unknown” + why
4) Backend contract: endpoints + response schema
5) Dependencies: stage_id tagging + policy eval windows + staleness

Attached:
- [Attachment: Dedicated_Staged_Rollouts_Console_Flow_v2.pdf]
- [Attachment: RolloutTimeline_wireframe_v3.png]
- [Attachment: GateEvidence_API_contract_draft.txt]

Concrete questions I need answered in the review:
- Gate “unknown” due to missing data: do we block Promote by default (fail-closed) with admin override? (Priya/Jordan discussed earlier; want final for Console copy.)
- Telemetry tags: what is the stable identifier we can use to request evidence? stage_id? stage_name? rollout_id + stage_index?
- Multi-region: do we show evidence per region or aggregated with a drilldown? (I prefer aggregated default, but need a clear rule.)

If you can’t make Tue, reply with conflicts and we’ll move.

Thanks,
Marissa
Product (Console & Rollouts)
Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 9:41 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console workflow review: Dedicated staged rollouts (timeline, promote/hold/abort, gate evidence)

Works for me.

Re: backend contract, two things we should settle in the meeting:
1) “Gate evidence” payload size + caching. If we return full query + observed series points it gets big fast. I’d like to return: gate_id, status, window, observed_value(s), threshold, and a link/handle to the dashboard panel.
2) Idempotency + optimistic concurrency for promote/abort. We already have this pattern in other rollout actions — we should ensure the Console backend can pass an idempotency key through.

Also: I’d like to avoid stage_name as a join key (mutable). stage_index + rollout_id is safer from a backend perspective.

-Chloe

Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console workflow review: Dedicated staged rollouts (timeline, promote/hold/abort, gate evidence)

I can make Tue.

On “unknown”:
- Policy engine default should be fail-closed when data is missing/stale beyond the staleness window.
- We will support an override mode (admin-only) that allows promotion with an explicit reason that is audit logged.

For Console copy, the key nuance is “unknown because telemetry is stale” vs “unknown because insufficient sample size”. Those need different operator guidance.

Also +1 to stable IDs: rollout_id + stage_index + gate_id. We’ll produce deterministic gate_id values per plan revision.

-Jordan

Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 10:37 AM PST
Subject: Re: Console workflow review: Dedicated staged rollouts (timeline, promote/hold/abort, gate evidence)

Can attend.

Telemetry side:
- We can emit stage_id as a derived label, but we need to control cardinality. The current plan is allowlisted labels: rollout_id, stage_index, pool_id, region.
- We should NOT label by stage_name.
- For evidence queries: please assume data can lag by ~1–3 minutes during peak ingest. Staleness detection should be explicit in the response (e.g., last_seen_at).

If we need per-region drilldown: we can support it, but default should be aggregated across regions to avoid exploding the UI.

(Logan)

Subject: Re: Console workflow review: Dedicated staged rollouts (timeline, promote/hold/abort, gate evidence)

+1 on splitting “unknown” reasons.

From a PM standpoint, I’d like us to standardize the gate evidence section to always show:
- Evaluation window (e.g., last 15m)
- Minimum sample size requirement + current sample
- Threshold and observed metric
- Pass/fail/unknown + explanation

Otherwise we’ll get stuck in support loops (“why can’t I promote?”) esp. for small pools.

Also: can we align on default stage names (Canary 1%, Ramp 10%, Ramp 50%, Full) and allow custom labels later? (Kenji had a simplified version in the wireframe.)

Paula

I can join.

RBAC / audit notes for the review:
- Promote/Hold/Abort should be available to customer admins for their pool (Dedicated), but Force-Promote should be Redwood-admin only for v1.
- Any override action needs an explicit “reason” string and should be visible in the audit trail.
- Console should treat override responses as “dangerous action completed” and show a warning banner with audit reference ID.

Kaitlyn

Subject: Re: Console workflow review: Dedicated staged rollouts (timeline, promote/hold/abort, gate evidence)

Thanks all — locking Tue 2/11 11:00–11:45a PT.

Based on replies, I’m updating what we’ll decide in the meeting:

Decisions to make:
1) Stable identifiers for gate evidence: rollout_id + stage_index + gate_id (no stage_name in joins)
2) “Unknown” taxonomy and UI copy:
   - Unknown (telemetry stale/missing) → blocks Promote by default; admin override permitted w/ reason + audit ID
   - Unknown (insufficient sample size) → blocks Promote; no override unless we explicitly add it later
3) Default evidence payload: no full time series; include window + sample size + threshold + observed + last_seen_at; link/handle to dashboards
4) Region breakdown: aggregated view by default + region drilldown behind a toggle (and only when multi-region pool)
5) Action permissions: customer admin gets Promote/Hold/Abort; Redwood admin only for Force-Promote (v1)

Prep for Console backend team (Chloe/Jada/Hannah): please come with feedback on whether the draft contract supports the ENG-5980 endpoints cleanly (list timeline, get evidence, promote, abort, hold).

Prep for policy/telemetry (Jordan/Logan/Allison): confirm staleness window recommendation (I’ve heard 5m vs 15m in other threads) and minimum sample sizes to avoid “promote on 3 requests”.

See you Tue.

-Marissa
